title: 糖果屋
description: 經典童話，糖果屋的故事

sentences.en: A poor family lived in the forest.
sentences.zh: 一個貧困的家庭住在森林裡。

sentences.en: The father left the children in the woods.
sentences.zh: 父親把孩子留在森林裡。

sentences.en: Hansel left breadcrumbs to find the way.
sentences.zh: 漢塞爾留下麵包屑來找路。

sentences.en: They found a house made of candy.
sentences.zh: 他們發現了一間用糖果做的房子。

sentences.en: A witch lived in the candy house.
sentences.zh: 一個女巫住在糖果屋裡。

sentences.en: The witch wanted to eat the children.
Gretel pushed the witch into the oven.
sentences.zh: 葛麗泰把女巫推進了烤爐。

sentences.en: Their father was happy to see them.
sentences.zh: 他們的父親很高見到他們。
他們幸福地生活在一起。
